criteria.requirement: Extend actual Timer context use with immutable context-local entry stacks and thread/task ownership, preserving sequential reuse and _enter_time compatibility after final exit. Same timer nested contexts must independently report full durations; child tasks inheriting a ContextVar must not close a parent-owned entry. Pop state before time/output callbacks, reject missing/repeated/cross-owner exit, preserve original business exception if ordinary output cleanup fails while propagating standalone output failure. Disabled output still cleans timing state. Do not change normal anonymous duration text or claim shared mutable private compatibility fields are the operational timing state.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
